description: PHASE 2 SLICE 1 — Identity & account settings foundation. Wire the FEAT-002 server-side privacy primitive (profiles.is_private) into the Dart client and add a real Settings surface. Adds `isPrivate` to the immutable UserProfile model (with copyWith/mapping), a private/public account toggle persisted to profiles.is_private (optimistic + guarded, mirroring ProfileRepository.updateProfile), an Edit Profile flow (display name + bio, already partially supported by updateProfile — wire the real UI and the currently-dead 'Edit profile' button on profile_screen.dart), and account-deletion + data-export SCAFFOLDING as clearly-marked, guarded stubs (no live execution possible: no service-role key / no reachable Supabase; the delete/export must NOT silently no-op-as-success — they surface an explicit 'not available in this build' state). A new SettingsScreen is reachable from the profile screen. All new pure logic (model mapping, toggle semantics, export payload assembly) is unit-tested against the MockData path without booting Supabase. This slice is self-contained and leaves analyze clean + tests green.
steps: Model: add `final bool isPrivate` (default false) to lib/models/user_profile.dart — add to the const constructor, the field list, and copyWith (bool? isPrivate). Keep id-based ==/hashCode unchanged. Update ProfileRepository._profileFromRow to map `is_private` -> isPrivate ((row['is_private'] as bool?) ?? false), mirroring the existing `verified` bool mapping.

ProfileRepository: add `void setAccountPrivate(bool isPrivate)` that optimistically updates _currentUser via copyWith(isPrivate: ...), fires exactly one notifyListeners() only when the value actually changes (idempotent, mirroring markNotificationsRead), and calls a guarded fire-and-forget `_persistPrivacy(bool)` that updates profiles.is_private for supabase.auth.currentUser?.id (try/catch swallow, no-op when unauthenticated). Extend the existing updateProfile/_persistProfile to remain the path for display_name/bio (no behavior change; keep the existing updateProfile test passing).

ProfileRepository: add account-deletion + data-export SCAFFOLDING as explicit, guarded stubs. Add `Future<AccountActionResult> requestAccountDeletion()` and `Future<DataExport> exportMyData()` (or similar) that assemble the export payload from the in-memory caches (current user profile + that user's posts via PostRepository + their comments) into a serializable Map/JSON string (this part is PURE and testable), but DO NOT claim live deletion/upload. Deletion returns a result indicating it is a scaffolded stub that requires a server-side privileged operation not available in this build (document why: account deletion needs service-role / an Edge Function; RLS-limited client cannot cascade-delete auth.users). Mark these clearly with doc comments referencing the environment constraint. Define a small immutable result type for the UI to render the 'scaffolded / not available' state.

UI: create lib/screens/settings_screen.dart — a Scaffold listening via AnimatedBuilder(animation: ProfileRepository.instance) with sections: Account (Edit profile -> opens edit flow; Private account SwitchListTile bound to currentUser.isPrivate -> setAccountPrivate), Privacy & Safety (placeholder entry points to the block/mute/report management added in FEAT-006 — may be simple navigation stubs this slice or wired in FEAT-006), Your data (Export my data -> triggers exportMyData and shows the assembled payload/preview or a 'scaffolded' notice; Delete account -> confirmation dialog then shows the scaffolded-not-available result), Sign out (reuse the existing AuthRepository.instance.signOut flow from profile_screen). Follow the dark-first theme (AppColors/AppTextStyles/AppSpacing). Handle loading/empty/error/disabled states for the data actions.

UI: create lib/screens/edit_profile_screen.dart (or a modal) with TextFormFields for display name + bio, pre-filled from currentUser, input validation (non-empty display name; bounded bio length), and Save -> ProfileRepository.instance.updateProfile(displayName:, bio:). Wire the currently-dead 'Edit profile' OutlinedButton in lib/screens/profile_screen.dart (_ProfileHeader) so that when isCurrentUser it navigates to EditProfileScreen; add a settings entry point (e.g. a settings IconButton in the profile SliverAppBar actions when _isCurrentUser) that navigates to SettingsScreen. Do not break the existing sign-out affordance.

MockData/regression: the toggle and export must work on the mock fallback path. Ensure ProfileRepository still constructs from MockData and existing profile_repository_test.dart assertions (notifications newest-first, updateProfile notifies once, etc.) pass UNCHANGED. currentUser.isPrivate defaults false via the model default.

Tests: add test/account_settings_test.dart (pure, no Supabase) covering: UserProfile.copyWith(isPrivate:) round-trips and other fields unchanged; setAccountPrivate flips currentUser.isPrivate and notifies exactly once, and is idempotent (second identical call does not notify); the data-export payload assembly includes the current user's profile + their posts and is well-formed (e.g. valid JSON / expected keys); the account-deletion stub returns the documented 'scaffolded / not available' result rather than claiming success. Keep test/profile_repository_test.dart passing without weakening it.

Run the verification loop and ensure no NEW analyzer issues and all tests green; discard the tooling-appended exclude block in analysis_options.yaml before finishing (git checkout analysis_options.yaml).
acceptance_criteria: UserProfile has an immutable `isPrivate` field wired through copyWith and ProfileRepository row-mapping (is_private)
ProfileRepository.setAccountPrivate optimistically toggles currentUser.isPrivate, notifies exactly once on change, is idempotent, and persists via a guarded fire-and-forget helper that no-ops offline

lib/screens/settings_screen.dart and an edit-profile flow exist and are reachable from profile_screen.dart; the previously-dead 'Edit profile' button now navigates; a private-account toggle is bound to currentUser.isPrivate

Account deletion and data export are present as CLEARLY-MARKED scaffolding: export assembles a real payload from in-memory data; deletion returns an explicit 'not available in this build / requires server-side privileged op' result and never falsely claims success
New unit tests in test/account_settings_test.dart pass; existing test/profile_repository_test.dart passes unchanged
`flutter analyze` reports only the 8 pre-existing baseline INFO lints (no NEW issues) and `flutter test` passes (64 baseline + new tests)
verification: export HOME=/tmp/fakehome PATH="/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH" PUB_CACHE=/opt/pub-cache && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test

Confirm via read that profile_screen.dart's Edit profile button has a real onPressed navigating to the edit flow and a settings entry point navigates to SettingsScreen; confirm setAccountPrivate persists to profiles.is_private in a guarded helper; confirm analysis_options.yaml has no committed exclude block
findings: Implemented Phase 2 Slice 1 (identity & account settings) fully in Dart + tests; SQL-free as planned. Changes: (1) lib/models/user_profile.dart gained an immutable `final bool isPrivate` (default false) wired through the const ctor and copyWith, id-based ==/hashCode unchanged. (2) lib/data/profile_repository.dart: _profileFromRow maps is_private -> isPrivate ((bool?) ?? false, mirroring `verified`); new setAccountPrivate(bool) optimistically copyWith's _currentUser, notifies exactly once ONLY on change (idempotent, mirrors markNotificationsRead), and calls guarded fire-and-forget _persistPrivacy(bool) that updates profiles.is_private for the auth user id and no-ops offline. updateProfile/_persistProfile unchanged (existing test still green). Added export/deletion scaffolding: exportMyData() assembles a real DataExport (profile + authored posts via PostRepository.forYou + authored comments via new CommentRepository.allByAuthor) into a serializable map/JSON (pure, testable); buildDataExport() is the pure injectable core. requestAccountDeletion() returns AccountActionResult.notAvailable with an explicit message — never claims success — documenting that cascade-deleting auth.users needs a server-side privileged op (service-role/Edge Function) unavailable to the RLS-limited client. New immutable result types AccountActionResult/AccountActionStatus and DataExport added at file end. (3) lib/data/comment_repository.dart: added allByAuthor(authorId) newest-first unmodifiable view. (4) UI: new lib/screens/settings_screen.dart (AnimatedBuilder on ProfileRepository.instance; Account section with Edit profile nav + Private-account SwitchListTile bound to currentUser.isPrivate -> setAccountPrivate; Privacy & Safety placeholder entries for FEAT-006 block/mute; Your data with Export -> bottom-sheet JSON preview and Delete -> confirm dialog then scaffolded not-available dialog; Sign out reusing AuthRepository.signOut). New lib/screens/edit_profile_screen.dart (Form with validated display name [non-empty, <=50] + bounded bio [<=160], Save -> updateProfile). (5) lib/screens/profile_screen.dart: wired the previously-dead 'Edit profile' OutlinedButton (onPressed navigates to EditProfileScreen when isCurrentUser, else null); added a Settings IconButton to the SliverAppBar actions for the current user; sign-out affordance preserved. (6) Tests: new test/account_settings_test.dart (11 tests) covering isPrivate default/copyWith round-trip, setAccountPrivate flip+single-notify+idempotency+guarded-no-throw, export payload assembly + valid JSON keys + injected posts/comments, and the deletion scaffolded not-available result. VERIFICATION: `flutter pub get` OK; `flutter analyze` = 8 pre-existing baseline INFO lints only, no NEW issues, exit 0 (fixed two self-introduced lints along the way: prefer_initializing_formals and Switch activeColor->activeThumbColor); `flutter test` = 75/75 pass (64 baseline + 11 new), existing profile_repository_test.dart unchanged and green. analysis_options.yaml tooling-appended exclude block discarded (not committed). ENV RISKS: no Android SDK/emulator so no apk/device/widget-golden verification; no reachable/administerable Supabase + no service-role key so live is_private persistence, data-export delivery, and account deletion are NOT verifiable here — guarded helpers no-op cleanly offline and deletion is explicit scaffolding by design. === V1 REVIEW FIXES (2026-09-08-121218-review.md) === Related cross-slice fix (implemented in FEAT-006): exportMyData() sources posts from PostRepository.forYou(), which now passes the viewer's own id as filterHidden's viewerId, so the viewer's own posts are exempt from any self-block/self-mute/muted-word filtering. Effect on export: a self-authored post that happens to contain one of the viewer's own muted words is NO LONGER excluded from their data export (previously it could be silently dropped). No change to the export payload shape or the honest deletion scaffolding. Verified via the full loop: analyze = 8 baseline lints, test = 122/122.
